## Checks

- [ ] Backend: `ruff check`, `ruff format --check`, `mypy`, and the tests for what changed
- [ ] Frontend: `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm build` (if touched)
- [ ] A model change ships its reviewed, autogenerated migration; `alembic check` is clean
- [ ] An API change regenerates `backend/openapi.json` and `frontend/src/lib/api-schema.d.ts`
- [ ] A new environment variable is in the service's `.env.example`, with a comment

## Docs

- [ ] A new system (job, integration, credential, pipeline, module) has its architecture section or README
- [ ] A decision that is expensive to reverse has its ADR, linked here
- [ ] No `docs/architecture/` claim is made false by this change
